I built the key-value HTTP server in C++20. It passes all 4 example cases in `node check.mjs`, and the build gives no compiler warnings.

I also tested some edge cases by hand against a running server:
- **Large values:** a 1 MiB random value came back byte-for-byte identical. A value 1 byte over the limit got `413`.
- **Invalid keys:** `/kv/`, `/kv/a/b`, `/kv/a%20b` and a 65-character key all got `400`. A 64-character key is accepted.
